nodes.name: Update error rows in a table

parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
    INSERT INTO news_content (news_id, description)
    VALUES ({{ $('Execute a SQL query1').item.json.id }}, $1)
    ON CONFLICT (news_id) DO UPDATE SET description = EXCLUDED.description
    RETURNING news_id
)
UPDATE news
SET status = 'content'
FROM c
WHERE news.id = c.news_id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.news n
SET status = 'fetching'
FROM (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.news
  WHERE url IS NOT NULL
    AND (status = 'pending' OR status IS NULL)
  ORDER BY rss_id, date
  LIMIT 100
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
) AS c
WHERE n.id = c.id
RETURNING n.id, n.rss_id, n.title, n.date, n.url;
